cat > report.py <<'EOF'
"""Build build/backtest.json: last vs 5-day moving average over seeds 0-9 (units/day)."""
from datetime import date, timedelta
import json
from pathlib import Path

from run import errors, series

SEEDS = range(10)
HORIZON = 5
START = date(2025, 1, 1)
CALENDAR_DAYS = 100
TARGET_REDUCTION = 0.20


def mae(values):
    return sum(values) / len(values)


def calendar_run(seed):
    """Score a date only if all 5 preceding calendar days are observed."""
    rows = series(seed)
    by_date = {r["date"]: r["value"] for r in rows}
    expected = [(START + timedelta(days=d)).isoformat() for d in range(CALENDAR_DAYS)]
    missing = [d for d in expected if d not in by_date]
    scored, last_err, mean_err = [], [], []
    for i in range(HORIZON, CALENDAR_DAYS):
        prev = expected[i - HORIZON:i]
        if expected[i] not in by_date or any(p not in by_date for p in prev):
            continue
        actual = by_date[expected[i]]
        last_err.append(abs(actual - by_date[prev[-1]]))
        mean_err.append(abs(actual - sum(by_date[p] for p in prev) / HORIZON))
        scored.append(expected[i])
    return {"seed": seed, "calendar_days": CALENDAR_DAYS, "observed_days": len(rows),
            "missing_dates": missing, "scored_count": len(scored),
            "skipped_count": CALENDAR_DAYS - HORIZON - len(scored),
            "scored_dates": scored, "mae_last": mae(last_err), "mae_mean5": mae(mean_err),
            "mae_reduction": 1 - mae(mean_err) / mae(last_err)}


def observation_run(seed):
    """Sensitivity: run.py's rule (previous 1 / 5 observed values, ignoring gaps)."""
    e = errors(series(seed))
    l, m = mae([x["last"] for x in e]), mae([x["mean5"] for x in e])
    return {"seed": seed, "scored_count": len(e), "mae_last": l, "mae_mean5": m,
            "mae_reduction": 1 - m / l}


def build():
    runs = [calendar_run(s) for s in SEEDS]
    sens = [observation_run(s) for s in SEEDS]
    pooled_l = mae([r["mae_last"] for r in runs])
    pooled_m = mae([r["mae_mean5"] for r in runs])
    red = 1 - pooled_m / pooled_l
    met = red >= TARGET_REDUCTION
    wins = sum(r["mae_mean5"] < r["mae_last"] for r in runs)
    conclusion = (
        f"Hypothesis {'supported' if met else 'NOT supported'}: the 5-day moving average "
        f"changed MAE by {-red:+.1%} relative to last observation "
        f"(mean5 {pooled_m:.3f} vs last {pooled_l:.3f} units/day, mean over seeds 0-9); "
        f"target was a reduction of at least {TARGET_REDUCTION:.0%}. mean5 beat last in "
        f"{wins}/{len(runs)} seeds. Cause: the series has a +1 unit/day trend, so a lagged "
        f"average is biased by ~3 units while last is biased by ~1; noise (+/-0.2) is too "
        f"small to offset it. The premise that every calendar day is observed is false: each "
        f"seed has {runs[0]['observed_days']} of {CALENDAR_DAYS} days "
        f"({len(runs[0]['missing_dates'])} missing). Only dates whose 5 preceding calendar "
        f"days are all observed were scored.")
    return {"units": "units per day", "metric": "MAE",
            "scoring_rule": "target date scored only if the 5 preceding calendar days are all "
                            "observed; last = previous day, mean5 = mean of previous 5 days",
            "target_reduction": TARGET_REDUCTION,
            "pooled": {"mae_last": pooled_l, "mae_mean5": pooled_m, "mae_reduction": red},
            "runs": runs,
            "sensitivity_observation_index_rule": sens,
            "conclusion": conclusion}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    out = Path("build/backtest.json")
    out.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(json.dumps(build(), indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.loads(out.read_text())["conclusion"])
EOF

def test_report_scores_only_gap_free_windows():
    from report import build
    rep = build()
    assert len(rep["runs"]) == 10
    for r in rep["runs"]:
        assert r["observed_days"] < r["calendar_days"] and r["missing_dates"]
        assert not set(r["scored_dates"]) & set(r["missing_dates"])
        assert r["scored_count"] + r["skipped_count"] == 95
        assert r["mae_mean5"] > r["mae_last"]
